tools.name: get_rental_listing_details
tools.description: Get full details for one rental listing by its ID (from search_rental_listings): photo, description, amenities, deposit, application fee, utilities, pet policy, and a virtual tour link when one exists. Show the photo and link to the person you're helping.

tools.name: requestAvailabilityUpdates
tools.description: Open an email to the Twin Oaks West leasing team asking for current availability and pricing.

tools.name: search_rental_listings
tools.description: Search current rental listings by price, bedrooms, bathrooms, pet policy, or a location keyword. Returns up to 4 matches, each with a photo, address, price, and link. Renting is visual — show each photo and link when presenting results to the person you're helping, not just plain text.

petsAllowed.description: Only show listings that allow pets.
